caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed horse saddle positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The saddle is rendered in shades of brown, with the seat and upper portion in a lighter tan color, and the lower side panel in a darker brown. The lower panel features intricate floral and scrollwork embossing. The stirrup is attached via a long, narrow leather strap, and is shown in a metallic grey color. The saddle horn and back rise (cantle) are accented in an off-white or pale ivory color, embellished with gold or light yellow decorative swirl patterns. The composition is uncluttered, with the saddle occupying the center of the page and no additional objects or background details present. The artist’s signature, “R. F. Miller,” appears in brown at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Side Saddle
